title: Observational maritime maintenance target-trial specification and identification gate

owns: asset/cluster identity and cluster-robust uncertainty declaration

paradigm.primary_question: Among units eligible at the same decision time, what would the outcome trajectory have been under each precisely defined maintenance strategy?
paradigm.design_first: The hypothetical trial is specified before outcome-driven model selection. The observational emulation is evaluated against the protocol, not retrofitted to a preferred estimator.
paradigm.time_zero: Eligibility, strategy assignment and follow-up start must share the same time zero for every emulation entry.
paradigm.temporal_leakage: Only covariates observed and available before time zero may enter the baseline confounder set. Post-treatment variables cannot be relabeled as baseline confounders.
paradigm.identification_abstention: Missing or violated exchangeability, consistency, positivity, interference, censoring or measurement assumptions force NOT_IDENTIFIED.
paradigm.cluster_unit: Repeated entries and telemetry rows are not independent assets. Cluster key and cluster-robust uncertainty must be explicitly declared.

hard_gates: The target-trial schema version and all trial/population identities must be valid.
Eligibility, assignment, causal graph and analysis plan each bind a SHA-256 digest.
At least two explicit treatment strategies must be declared.
Every strategy binds a version digest and definition digest.
Physical repair, alternative repair, sensor-only correction, deferred/usual care and dynamic strategies remain separate strategy versions.
A non-zero treatment grace period requires an explicit clone-censor-weight design.
At least one primary outcome with metric, unit and definition digest must be declared.
Baseline covariates must be explicitly defined and carry definition digests.
Post-treatment or unknown-timing covariates cannot be declared as baseline adjustment variables.
Eligibility, strategy assignment and follow-up start must be aligned at time zero.
Every emulation entry has a unique entry ID and a non-empty asset cluster ID.
The cluster key and grouping rule digest must be declared.
Cluster-robust uncertainty must be declared for all observational estimands.
A parallel-group emulation cannot place the same physical asset in more than one strategy arm.
Sequential-trial and clone-censor-weight designs may reuse assets only as distinct emulation entries and must preserve cluster identity.
Every emulation entry is assigned to a declared strategy.
Declared strategy-arm entry counts must match the timeline records exactly and must not be duplicated.
Every declared baseline covariate has source evidence for each emulation entry.
Baseline covariate evidence must be available no later than time zero.
Eligibility, assignment, follow-up and treatment-start timestamps must be finite, non-negative and temporally consistent.
A treatment start must fall within the strategy's declared grace period and before follow-up ends.
A deferred/usual-care strategy must not contain a physical treatment-start record.
Administrative follow-up cannot terminate before the preregistered horizon; early termination must be represented as censoring, outcome or a competing event.
All six required identifying assumptions must have one evidence-bound assessment and reviewer reference.
Any unknown, violated or missing identifying assumption forces NOT_IDENTIFIED.
Common support, effective sample size, standardized balance and stabilized-weight diagnostics must meet the preregistered thresholds.
Follow-up completeness must meet the preregistered threshold.
Negative-control status must be supported; unknown or violated controls force NOT_IDENTIFIED.
The diagnostic snapshot digest and its emulation-entry/cluster counts must match the declared data snapshot.
The report must distinguish protocol_incomplete, not_identified and design_qualified_for_estimator.
The validator never estimates a causal effect and all maintenance/restoration/operating authorizations remain false.
The declared cluster key must resolve to the physical asset identity represented in each timeline row.
Sensitivity-analysis status must be supported before the design can qualify for an estimator.
Negative-control disposition must bind an evidence digest and reviewer reference.
Sensitivity-analysis disposition must bind an evidence digest and reviewer reference.

diagnostics.note: Defaults are synthetic benchmark thresholds only. A real emulation must preregister justified thresholds for its target population and strategy.

estimators_not_yet_implemented: unadjusted pre/post and standard regression as association-only baselines
standardization or g-computation for static baseline strategies
inverse-probability weighting and marginal structural models for longitudinal treatment
augmented inverse-probability weighting and TMLE where assumptions apply
clone-censor-weight for dynamic strategies and grace periods
longitudinal g-formula for time-varying confounding affected by prior treatment
partial identification and quantitative sensitivity analysis

cases.scenario: Complete protocol, aligned time zero, pre-treatment covariates, supported assumptions and overlap.
Eligibility, assignment and follow-up start are not aligned.
Baseline covariate becomes available after time zero.
Post-treatment variable is declared as a baseline adjustment covariate.
Conditional exchangeability is unknown or violated.
Common support and effective sample size fall below preregistered thresholds.
Treatment grace period is present but clone-censor-weight design is not declared.
Negative-control status is unknown or violated.
Follow-up completeness falls below the target-trial threshold.
Sequential trial reuses the same asset under distinct emulation-entry IDs and cluster-robust design.
Parallel-group emulation places one physical asset in both strategy arms.
Administrative end truncates follow-up before the preregistered horizon.
A deferred/usual-care strategy is recorded with a physical treatment start.
Duplicate or unknown strategy-arm count metadata is supplied.
Missing or duplicated baseline covariate evidence or invalid evidence digest.
The declared cluster key is a telemetry row identity rather than the physical asset key.
No reviewed sensitivity analysis is attached to the emulation diagnostic snapshot.
Negative-control and sensitivity statuses are marked supported but their evidence digests/reviewer receipts are absent or invalid.

claim_ceiling: A design_qualified_for_estimator result means only that the declared protocol and available diagnostics passed this structural gate. It is not a causal effect estimate, proof of unmeasured-confounding absence, a marine-engine validation or permission to operate.
